About SmileCare Dental & Skin Clinic

For us, a good consultation starts with someone listening.

Most people walk in already worried. So we don’t jump to conclusions. We ask what you’re going through, examine you, and then explain which treatments are worth considering, and which are not needed at all.

Our small clinic in Sigra, Varanasi is run by two doctors. You can get dental care and skin care in the same visit: teeth problems, braces, clear aligners and implants on one side, and acne, pigmentation, uneven skin tone, allergies and acne scars on the other.

We want your visit to feel easy.

How We Can Help

Dental and skin problems don’t look the same in everyone. That’s why the treatment can’t be the same either.

At SmileCare, we start by understanding your problem. The doctor examines you and then explains which treatments could make sense in your case.

Toothache, teeth that don’t line up, a missing tooth, or a skin problem you need advice on: whatever brings you in, you’re welcome to book a consultation.

Dental Services

Root Canal Treatment

When infection or deep decay reaches the inside of a tooth, a root canal may be needed. The doctor will examine the tooth first and tell you whether it’s the right option for you.

Braces

Braces gradually move crooked or crowded teeth into a better position. How long it takes, and which type is suitable, depends on the condition of your teeth.

Clear Aligners

If you want straighter teeth but don’t like the idea of traditional braces, aligners are one option. During the consultation, the doctor will look at your teeth and tell you whether they’d work for you.

Dental Implants

A missing tooth can make eating and smiling harder. An implant is one way to replace it. Before anything is decided, the doctor checks your gums, your teeth and your overall oral health.

Dental Fillings

A cavity may need a filling. The type of filling depends on how much the tooth has been damaged.

Dental Cleaning

Brushing alone doesn’t always remove the plaque and tartar that build up on teeth. A professional cleaning clears those deposits and is a regular part of looking after your mouth.

Skin Care Services

Acne Scar Laser Treatment

After acne clears up, some people are left with scars or uneven skin texture. In some cases, laser treatment can help. The doctor needs to look closely at your skin and scars before deciding anything.

Uneven Skin Tone Treatment

Uneven skin tone can have many causes, so the treatment depends on what’s going on with your skin. You can talk through your concern during the consultation.

Pigmentation Treatment

Dark patches can come from things like sun exposure or changes in the skin. It’s important to find the cause and type first. Treatment options can be discussed after that.

Skin Allergy Treatment

A skin allergy can show up as itching, redness, irritation or other symptoms. If you’re dealing with something like this, a consultation can help you understand what’s happening and what kind of care is appropriate.

Acne & Pimples Treatment

Acne isn’t the same for everyone. Some people get the odd pimple, while others deal with frequent breakouts or marks that stay behind. The doctor will look at your skin and talk through treatment based on your concern.
